blocks.text: Day 5 · 07:00 breakfast · 08:00 jungle walk and visit to a caboclo’s house, learning how manioc flour is prepared · 12:00 lunch · 15:00 visit to the village of Acajatuba, whose people live from manioc plantations, fishing and fruits such as tucumã, cupuaçu and açaí, as well as rubber and Brazil-nut trees, and make crafts with natural seeds from the jungle · 19:00 farewell dinner · 20:00 explore the riverbank by searchlight to spot caimans, and sometimes nighthawks, snakes and frogs. Activities may vary according to the lodge and the season.

blocks.text: Day 6 · Transfer to the airport and flight to Salvador da Bahia; our driver meets you and takes you to the hotel. Salvador, the African soul of Brazil, is where the descendants of enslaved Africans have preserved their cultural roots more than anywhere else in the Americas: hypnotic drumbeats, graceful movement, fragrant spices and festivals such as its famous Carnival. Even on an ordinary day you may come across a capoeira circle or taste acarajé, bean and shrimp fritters fried in dendê oil.
